Latest clues found in the WhatsApp TestFlight beta suggest that Meta is developing an alternative to iCloud backups for iPhone users. Details below.

WhatsApp Developing Proprietary Backup Service

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users, offering an option beyond iCloud.

This feature is not yet available to WhatsApp TestFlight users, but WABetaInfo managed to activate an interface that allows users to choose between iCloud and WhatsApp's proprietary cloud service for backups. The interface promises 2GB of free storage, and the report also indicates paid plans could offer up to 1TB of capacity.

The report also points out that users can choose whether WhatsApp backups on iCloud should use end-to-end encryption, but WhatsApp's proprietary backup system will have end-to-end encryption enabled by default.

Although the official launch timeline for this feature has yet to be announced, the report notes that WhatsApp is also developing a Google Drive backup alternative for Android users. With development work proceeding simultaneously on both platforms, this feature could be officially announced very soon.
